mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a completed four-hour canonical Awesome Oscillator zero crossing identifies a shift between short and long median-price momentum; follow the new sign for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when AO crosses strictly above zero; short when AO crosses strictly below zero
mechanism.why_distinct: AO subtracts a 34-period simple average of bar median price from its 5-period simple average. It uses neither EMA recursion nor close-only crossover, prior candidate repair, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour median-price dual-horizon zero crossings are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.awesome_oscillator: causal SMA(5) median price minus causal SMA(34) median price, both complete and reset across source gaps
features.event: current completed AO strictly crosses above zero from <=0 or below zero from >=0
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical Awesome Oscillator 5/34 zero crossing under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no SMA period, price basis, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: Bill Williams canonical Awesome Oscillator convention
external_basis.fixed_definition: 5-period SMA minus 34-period SMA of median price (high+low)/2; strict zero-line crossover
external_basis.selection_use: published 5/34 median-price formula and zero-line direction only; no incidence or outcomes
